answer: Layered bond: a newcomer pays 30 and locks 70 in three opal layers: 20, 25, 25 free after each job and a clean epoch. At the epoch zenith, auditors wander the stack; a reused receipt burns it all. 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 stacks: 30,000 fees, 70,000 locked, 100,000 against a 40,000 pool. Failure: the stacked-receipt ring; rented layers fail the wander audit. Honest newcomers pay 30 once; all layers unlock after a clean epoch.
